meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 15 (DECISIONS 037, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 4 new models, 17 quotes. Batch split: the fifth candidate, Sony INZONE H7, was NOT added — discontinued by Sony (Audio46 lists it 'Discontinued'; Headphone Zone: 'permanently discontinued by the manufacturer'); the Meta Catalog feed returns no Sony-direct or Best Buy H7 row, and only ListenUp still lists it ($228.00, Available) — the Pro Display XDR precedent (batch 14), not a reason to force it in. The candidate '~$349.99 launch price' was also wrong: the H7 launched in 2022 at $229.99 US (Audio46 $229.99; GamesRadar $200 after a launch-price adjustment). CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) Studio Display XDR $3,299 is confirmed current — it is the standard-glass tilt-and-height config (MFEL4LL/A); $2,899 is the standard-glass VESA config (MFEN4LL/A) and $3,599 / $3,199 are the nano-texture configs. (2) The MDR-M1 candidate price $269.99 is confirmed current-ish — $268 at B&H and Sweetwater, $269.99 at Vintage King; $249.99 is the launch MSRP, not the current street price. (3) The MDR-MV1 candidate price $339.99 matches no US price — the MSRP is $419.99 and the current US street price is $418–$419.99. (4) The Keychron B39 candidate price $54.99 is confirmed current at Keychron direct (Deep Black, Available). All four identifier sets stay pending (single-source-only or no-source codes — see catalog notes): XDR — no UPC for MFEL4LL/A on any US retailer spec page (B&H 195950527650 belongs to the VESA MFEN4LL/A); MDR-M1 UPC 027242930612 on the B&H spec page only (manuals.plus mirrors the Amazon ASIN listing and Amazon is not used for corroboration); MDR-MV1 UPC 027242926585 in an eBay listing only; B39 SKU B39-K9 on the Keychron page only, no UPC anywhere. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{apple-studio-display-xdr,sony-mdr-m1,sony-mdr-mv1,sony-inzone-h7,keychron-b39}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~19:01-19:03 UTC (11:01-11:03 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase.
